{{Quote|Bink, would you do me a favor and get me a small plate of those carni chips?''"<br />"''Sure.|Lando Calrissian and Bink Kitik|<ref name="Scoundrels" />}}
'''Carni chips''' were a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] edible by [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. They could be found on the<ref name="Scoundrels" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on coresponding data for [[Wukkar system/Legends|Wukkar system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]].<ref name="Scoundrels" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ScoundrelsD">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Scoundrels]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> while staying in a suite on the planet, the Human [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] asked the [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Bink Kitik]] to give him a small plate of carni chips. Shortly after, Calrissian ate a helping of them.<ref name="Scoundrels" />

==Behind the scenes==
Carni chips were mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2013]] novel ''[[Scoundrels]]''.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
